svg.title: Episode 02: Screenie
svg.desc: Screenie: a menu-bar screenshot tool for macOS 14+, written in Swift 6. Area, window and timed capture, annotation, OCR via Apple Vision, and a pixel ruler. 20-capture history, 6 annotation tools, no Dock icon. Art: a marching-ants selection on a tiny desktop, and a camera flash: snap!

g.text: OCR via Apple Vision, pixel ruler.
